raw_record.question_text: Bia has five coins as shown in the image. She wants to buy a fruit using exactly three coins and receive no change. What price can she not pay exactly?

method.method_draft: First read the five coin denominations from the image: 1 real, 50 centavos, 25 centavos, 10 centavos, and 5 centavos. From the question text, use the constraint that Bia must use exactly three of these five coins and receive no change. Enumerate every 3-coin combination and its total: 1.75, 1.60, 1.55, 1.35, 1.30, 1.15, 0.85, 0.80, 0.65, and 0.40 reais. Then compare the fruit prices/options to this set; the price 1,40 is not among the possible exact totals, so it is the one she cannot pay exactly.
method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理链整体正确：先描述图像中五枚硬币的面额，再根据“恰好三枚且不找零”的条件枚举所有三枚组合，总额计算无误，最终答案与标准答案 1,40 一致。唯一可改进处是若原题有水果价格选项，可明确写成“在给定选项中，1,40 不在这些可支付金额内”。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct exhaustive-combination route: identify all coin values visually, list all possible sums using exactly three coins, and check which candidate price is absent.
planner_metadata.image_role: The image provides the five available coin denominations: R$1,00, R$0,50, R$0,25, R$0,10, and R$0,05.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text supplies the requirement to use exactly three coins and receive no change, and asks for the price that cannot be paid exactly.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use basic currency addition and the combinatorial rule that exactly three distinct coins must be selected from the five shown; a payable price must equal one of those 3-coin sums.
